errors.text: The proposed dominant mechanism is incorrect: the target attributes yield onset to defect-assisted nucleation of Shockley partial dislocations at vacancy clusters, not thermally activated screw-dislocation cross-slip or double-kink motion.
The double-kink and high-Peierls-barrier argument is imported primarily from BCC refractory MoNbTaW evidence and is not valid support for the FCC FeNiCrMn system.
The specified strain-rate regime is substantially wrong: 10^-4–10^3 s^-1 does not reconstruct the molecular-dynamics range of 10^8–10^10 s^-1 on which the reported rate insensitivity is bounded.
